ABORIGINAL 
HEAD START 


STATEMENT 
OF PRINCIPLE 


Health Canada supports 
Indians, Métis and Inuit 
in their recognition 
of children as the nation’s 
most valuable resource. 
On that premise, 
the Aboriginal 
Head Start Initiative 
sets out to provide 
comprehensive experiences 
for Indian, Métis and Inuit 
children and their families. 
It will be based on 
caring, creativity and pride 


flowing from the knowledge 


of their traditional beliefs, 
within a holistic 
and safe environment. 


Our mission is help the people of Canada 
maintain and improve their health 
Health Canada 


Published by authority of 
the Minister of National Health and Welfare 


Minister of Supply and Services Ganada 1995, 
Cat.No. H34-68/1995B 
ISBN 0-662-23500-2 


Egalement disponible en frangais sous le titre 
Programme d'aide préscolaire aux Autochtones 


and whose primary concern is 
the health and well-being of 


@ Foster a desire in the child for life- 
long learning.
